description: This file contains classes and functions for aggregating responses from a Large Language Model (LLM), including handling conversation context, message accumulation, and managing function calls and speech events in conversational AI pipelines.

classes.name: LLMFullResponseAggregator
classes.description: Aggregates complete LLM responses between start and end frames, providing a callback when a full response is assembled.

classes.name: BaseLLMResponseAggregator
classes.description: Abstract base class for all LLM response aggregators, managing message flow and conversation state.

classes.name: LLMContextResponseAggregator
classes.description: Uses an OpenAI LLM context for storing conversation and manages context frames.

classes.name: LLMUserContextAggregator
classes.description: Handles user speech transcription aggregation, managing VAD emulation, interruptions, and timing.

classes.name: LLMUserResponseAggregator
classes.description: Extends user aggregator to output message frames instead of context frames.

classes.name: LLMAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: Handles assistant responses, including text, function calls, and timestamping.

classes.name: LLMAssistantResponseAggregator
classes.description: Extends assistant aggregator to output message frames instead of context frames.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, managing aggregation, context, and function calls.

methods.name: push_aggregation
methods.description: Pushes current aggregation downstream, including context and timestamp frames.

methods.name: _handle_llm_start
methods.description: Handles the start of an LLM response.

methods.name: _handle_llm_end
methods.description: Handles the end of an LLM response.

methods.name: _handle_text
methods.description: Handles text frames, appending text to the current aggregation.

methods.name: _handle_llm_messages_append
methods.description: Handles appending messages to the context.

methods.name: _handle_llm_messages_update
methods.description: Handles updating messages in the context.

methods.name: _handle_interruptions
methods.description: Handles interruption frames, resetting aggregation and context.

methods.name: _handle_function_calls_started
methods.description: Handles the start of function calls.

methods.name: _handle_user_image_frame
methods.description: Handles user image frames related to function calls.

methods.name: _create_aggregation_task
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous task for managing aggregation timeout.

methods.name: _aggregation_task_handler
methods.description: Main loop for handling aggregation timeout and emulation logic.
